subject: Average shape for a group along a certain principal component

messages.author: 118f18f9e4d28c75
messages.subject: Average shape for a group along a certain principal component
parts:
Hi,

I'm aware that it's possible to get the minimum and maximum shape of a certain principal component (e.g. $shapes$shapes.comp1$min/max). However is there a way to get the average shape of a group (i.e.a subsample of the entire population) along a certain principal component?

Thanks

messages.author: 4d71c6e24fb21497
messages.subject: RE: [geomorph-r-package] Average shape for a group along a certain principal component
parts:
Yes. Use ‘mean’ in your code rather than ‘min’ or ‘max’.

messages.subject: RE: [geomorph-r-package] Average shape for a group along a certain principal component
parts:
Yes, the function shape.predictor can do this for all manner of predictions.

 

If you look at the help file for this function, the first example is predicting shapes along PC1.  The example uses min and max: this is where you can add mean to it.

 

Dean
